_about: Builder steps whose command is not run on the example data by tests/notebooks/test_builder_examples.py, each with the reason. Every other builder step is run there exactly as the builder shows it.

reasons.METAL|METAL: No example summary statistics for several cohorts yet; the command has placeholder paths.
reasons.RNA_calling|STAR_align: Needs the full GRCh38 reference (several GB of downloads and a STAR/RSEM index); run on SCC, not on the example data.
reasons.RNA_calling|rnaseqc_call: Reads the BAM files STAR_align makes, which needs the full GRCh38 reference and STAR index; run on SCC with the reference job.
reasons.RNA_calling|rsem_call: Needs the full GRCh38 reference (several GB of downloads and a STAR/RSEM index); run on SCC, not on the example data.
reasons.mixture_prior|ud_unconstrained: The udr TED update stops on the small example data (it needs z-scale input with one shared V).
